analysis.reasonEn: RSI declined from 65.2 to 58.0, cooling from overbought territory. MACD histogram continues to improve from 0.4774 to 0.7176. The 5-day low of $94.45 is forming a Higher Low pattern relative to the 20-day low of $85.81. Volume ratio of 0.28 indicates a contraction, lowering trend confidence. Current price $94.96 is consolidating near the Bollinger Band middle line $91.32. No clear trend reversal signal confirmed, hence wait-and-see.
